## Où j'en suis
The PostgreSQL 17 upgrade for the analytics RDS is successfully deployed on staging (PG 17.2) via a blue/green deployment, and the PR is open with the logical replication and engine changes committed. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57)

- [en-cours] Observing staging on PG 17.2 for a full week without incident before Maya signs off on production. (source: src-linear-kes298, s3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the production window, scheduling a first downtime for the logical replication reboot and a second for the blue/green switchover. (source: s3-10, src-slack-infra)
- [essai-raté] Initial blue/green apply failed because rds.logical_replication was not set to 1, requiring a static parameter change and a reboot. (source: s3-04, s3-05)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR. (source: s1-02, src-pr57)
